create_SimpleMob: create a SimpleMob instance with opts and optional start position for simulated mob movement
create_LoopMob: create a LoopMob instance with opts and a move sequence for predefined path looping
call_make_mob_opts: call make_mob_opts with a mob name like rabbit to generate its behavior options object
call_SimpleMob_step: call step on a SimpleMob to simulate one tick of movement, falling, and loitering logic
call_SimpleMob_add_to_world: call add_to_world on a SimpleMob to place it into a world with random or set position
